about.page.reason: Page shell composes template parts and nested content/lead components; it has no direct data query worth caching at this level.

aiagents.reason: Page shell owns AI agents layout, inline lead form and nested content/FAQ wrappers; cache is delegated below.

calculator.page.reason: Calculator page shell includes chat, FAQ and lead CTA surfaces with runtime state; cache is delegated to child components where applicable.

chat.surface.reason: Chat surface is a JS runtime mount with per-page surface params and transient browser state; no server-side data query is performed.

contact.modal.reason: Contact modal renders a form runtime mount and has no server data query; POST protection is enforced by REST endpoint CSRF/origin/rate checks.

contacts.page.reason: Contacts page shell prepares static office/map params and nested CTA; there is no direct Bitrix content query in the shell.

content.detail.reason: Wrapper normalizes params and delegates detail HTML/data cache to bitrix:news.detail with explicit CACHE_TYPE/CACHE_TIME.

content.list.reason: Wrapper normalizes params and delegates list HTML/data cache to bitrix:news.list with explicit CACHE_TYPE/CACHE_TIME.

faq.section.reason: FAQ wrapper resolves section scope and delegates FAQ item cache to bitrix:news.list with explicit CACHE_TYPE/CACHE_TIME.

home.page.reason: Home page shell composes static sections and nested chat/content/FAQ/lead components; cache ownership stays with children or runtime surfaces.

lead.cta.reason: Lead CTA renders a form runtime mount with contextual hidden fields; it has no server data query and must keep per-call lead context intact.

offer.reason: Offer section router receives resolved request state, then delegates list cache to offer.catalog service cache and detail cache to bitrix:news.detail.

offer.catalog.reason: Catalog data is cached by Tacticum\Offer\CatalogService with Data\Cache and managed iblock tag invalidation.

price.page.reason: Price page shell composes price builder, chat, content, FAQ and lead CTA surfaces; cache ownership stays with children or runtime surfaces.

product.hero.reason: Product hero renders prepared page data and source/status markers without direct data query; product page cache ownership stays with product.page/product content services.

product.lead.cta.reason: Product CTA normalizes prepared product CTA params and delegates form runtime rendering to lead.cta; it has no direct server data query.

product.page.reason: Product page component prepares/render product data through product content services; Bitrix product source uses Data\Cache and managed iblock tag invalidation.

services.page.reason: Services page shell composes content lists, FAQ and lead CTA; cache ownership stays with child content wrappers.
